beats.caption: Tahun 2003. Pulang sekolah, tas belum ditaruh, langsung ke warnet.
beats.caption_en: The year is 2003. Straight from school to the warnet, backpack still on.

beats.caption: Mas operator kasih voucher di kertas kuning. Rp 3.000 sejam.
